dedupe_keys.name: a 30m african cropland layer for 2016 by integrating multiple remote sensing crowdsource and auxiliary datasets

description: Nabil and colleagues provide a 30 m binary cropland layer for Africa with nominal year 2016. Science Data Bank lists a PUBLIC CC BY 4.0 release with seven files totalling 1.65 GB; its page links a Figshare copy that also states CC BY 4.0 and the same title. The team combined four land-cover sources covering 2015 to 2017, checked their accuracy by agro-ecological zone and joined preferred zones into one map. An infrastructure modeller could use the cropland mask to estimate agricultural exposure to drought, transport disruption or irrigation-service changes. It is land cover, not crop yield, farm boundaries or the operating condition of irrigation assets. The nominal 2016 map may include observations from adjacent years, so it should not be interpreted as an exact single-date census. Neither repository archive was downloaded. Pixel coding, coordinate system, no-data areas and local accuracy remain unchecked. The Science Data Bank and Figshare DOIs describe one output and should not become two catalogue records. Limitations include uncertain local accuracy and temporal mismatch among source maps. Related asset and irrigation-network layers are needed for service simulations.
name: A 30m African Cropland Layer for 2016 by Integrating Multiple Remote sensing, Crowdsource, and Auxiliary Datasets
